{{Quote|It’s the Whistling Wind, about three blocks south and west of the palace gate. You need to get here as quickly as you can.|Vestin Axlon to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Whistling Wind''' was a tapcaf located in [[Whitestone City]] on [[Poln Major]]. The [[Hand of Judgment]] hid [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] in its basement when [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s troops made attempts against Governor's life.
